row.notes: Team table loader. rcx = the entrants system, dl = the team set (0x142461443 passes 1, 0x142483002 passes 0). Replaces the set's slot vector at system+0x2c8+set*0x10 with a new empty one (allocator from system+0x10), then iterates the entrants.teams cursor (count _team_instancecount_, 358 stock) and for every row whose available is true builds a TeamRecord on the stack (rsp+0xfe0; structs/TeamRecord.h): the row label, display_name/_code/_short/_super_short, timing_tower_texture_path, livery_name, team_base (strings, empty when absent), audio_id, the 7 colours (signed ARGB int32 read without a null check, so a row missing a colour key crashes), show_team_badge, show_custom_badge_in_UI, team_colour_valid, nationality/team_boss/expression_label/animation_set as stat ids of their rows found by label (entrants.nationality, entrants.characters, entrants.expression_label, entrants.animation.driver_animation_sets), prestige, the optional <row>.paddockMarker, the first story_info row's description and hashtag (missing _story_info_instancecount_ = no story), the row path, and the key stat_id << 16; then Team_Insert_RecordByStatId (0x1424697f4) stores it at slots[stat_id] (a duplicate stat id is dropped). Posts a message (vt 0x14578d610) on g_Game_MessageBus at the end. Callers: census steam 0x2469440. | earlier L1 note: team table loader: Gdb_Init_TableCursor(entrants.teams), per available row reads 25 fields (display_name*, colours, livery_name, team_base, team_boss, prestige, stat_id...), resolves nationality/animation/character/expression_label rows by label, and walks the nested table <team row>.story_info_N (description, hashtag; missing count -> 0 rows)

Correction: the record key is stat_id<<16 with no set byte for any set (0x14246c499), and the loader reads the same entrants.teams cursor for both sets. The note 'dl = the team set' also holds only for the vector choice (system+0x2c0+set*0x10).
